summary: The blind compare flagged two ambiguous clozes: 065 (我一直觉得…原来 is natural) and 083 (适合的礼物 is common usage); 065 now contrasts only 以为/认为 and 083 was rebuilt around 正合适. Systematic fixes: 觉得 distractors removed from the other 以为…原来 items (061, 067), 还 vs 再 next to 想 removed per the guide (022, 023, 027 replaced), and several why lines that stated false reasons (033, 073) corrected. Judgement calls left: 以为 as distractor in 064/066 (literary 以为 = 认为 is rare in speech) and 认为…原来 in judge 070 kept as wrong, following the guide.

near-synonyms-02-007.note: why rewritten: the old reason for rejecting 了解 was garbled.

near-synonyms-02-017.note: en made natural (knows the rules inside out).

near-synonyms-02-019.note: Judge sentence reordered to the natural topic-first 这张表我看清楚了，可是没看懂; en adjusted.

near-synonyms-02-022.note: Removed 还 distractor: the guide forbids clozing 还 vs 再 next to 想, and 明天还看一遍 is borderline colloquially.

near-synonyms-02-023.note: Removed 还 distractor (guide: do not cloze 还 vs 再 next to 想).

near-synonyms-02-027.note: Replaced: 还想 vs 再 next to 想 is excluded by the guide; new item tests 还 = still, decided by the cue and 一个上午.

near-synonyms-02-033.note: why corrected: 以后 alone exists (from now on); the real reason is that it looks forward.

near-synonyms-02-036.note: why wording: clause + 以后 means after X, not after that.

near-synonyms-02-061.note: Dropped 觉得 distractor: 我觉得你不会来了，原来… is said by natives, so the item was ambiguous in the same way as 065.

near-synonyms-02-065.note: Blind compare AMBIGUOUS: 我一直觉得…原来… is natural. Removed 一直 and the 觉得 distractor; 认为 + 原来 is the guide's classic error.

near-synonyms-02-067.note: Dropped 觉得 distractor for the same reason as 065 (觉得…原来 is acceptable colloquially).

near-synonyms-02-073.note: why was false (参观 does follow 去 + place, as in item 074); now states the real reason.

near-synonyms-02-083.note: Blind compare AMBIGUOUS: 适合的礼物 is common native usage. Replaced with 正合适, where 适合 would need an object.

near-synonyms-02-087.note: why tightened to mainland usage (一次难忘的经验 occurs in Taiwan usage).
